up: Retrieve exact IC50 values in nM for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251). Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, target_organism, and exact_ic50_value. Filters: target CHEMBL ID = 'CHEMBL5251', target organism = 'Homo sapiens', activity standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', standard_relation = '='. Only include rows where a PubMed ID or DOI is available and the compound has a canonical SMILES string. Join tables: activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_records, compound_structures, docs.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(docs.pubmed_id AS TEXT), docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, assays.description AS assay_description, td.organism AS target_organism, ac.standard_value AS exact_ic50_value FROM activities ac JOIN assays ON ac.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON assays.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON ac.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs ON ac.doc_id = docs.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ac.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5251' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND ac.standard_type = 'IC50' AND ac.standard_units = 'nM' AND ac.standard_relation = '=' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL)
